<thought>We need to find a template that breaks a trimethylsilyl group and an aliphatic hydroxyl group and forms an alkene (C‑C double bond). Using the available functional group list, we will search the template catalog with these criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Si", "C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
